text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With every racer shouldering the hopes of 
the crowd— Matikanetannhauser was no 
exception.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When asked by an interviewer which girl he 
was rooting for, the round-glasses 
reporter answered "Matikanetannhauser" 
without hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, in the paddock, Machikane 
Tannhauser receives a declaration of war 
from Mejiro McQueen: "I can feel your 
recent rapid growth firsthand."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A lineup of unique Umamusume gathers for 
the Takarazuka Kinen! Let's stay focused 
and aim for victory!
